hook: Coins, Diamonds and cash are NOT the same thing.

points.label: Coins
points.body: Viewers buy Coins to send you Gifts during a LIVE.

points.label: Diamonds
points.body: TikTok's separate reward metric, earned from eligible Gifts.

points.label: The trap
points.body: There's no fixed Diamond-to-dollar rate. Check your own LIVE rewards balance.

points.label: Region varies
points.body: TikTok says the follower threshold can change by region.

points.label: Age gate
points.body: You must be 18+ and may be asked to verify your age.

points.label: If it's missing
points.body: Check standing and account notices, then Settings → Report a problem.

hook: Going LIVE and getting Gifts are two different unlocks.

points.label: Separate
points.body: LIVE access does not automatically turn on Gifts.

points.label: Depends on
points.body: Your region, eligibility, and good standing.

points.label: Check
points.body: Look for LIVE Gifts in your LIVE settings — it may not be yours to toggle.

takeaway: Don't assume one unlocks the other.

hook: Winning a LIVE Match is NOT a payout.

points.label: Match points
points.body: Gifts and likes build a score that decides the winner.

points.label: Not cash
points.body: Match points aren't Diamonds, and Diamonds aren't guaranteed cash.

points.label: How to start
points.body: Co-host → Match → pick a mode → send the invite.

takeaway: Play for reach, not a scoreboard myth.

hook: Mute and Block are not the same move.

points.label: Muted
points.body: They can still watch — they just can't comment.

points.label: Blocked
points.body: They can't view your LIVE at all until you unblock them.

points.label: Scale it
points.body: Assign moderators — they only get the permissions you grant.

takeaway: Control the room without killing it.

hook: Phone LIVE does NOT unlock PC LIVE.

points.label: LIVE Studio
points.body: TikTok's PC tool — desktop access is approved separately.

points.label: Check status
points.body: Confirm your LIVE access inside LIVE Studio, then apply if offered.

points.label: No shortcuts
points.body: Don't trust unofficial 'stream key' bypasses.

hook: Your LIVE replay is free content for 30 days.

points.label: Where
points.body: Profile → TikTok Studio → LIVE → LIVE recordings.

points.label: Do this
points.body: Download it and clip your best moments.

points.label: Then
points.body: Cross-post those clips everywhere — one upload, every platform.

hook: Announce your LIVE before you ever go on.

points.label: LIVE Events
points.body: Schedule a LIVE so viewers register for a reminder.

points.label: Where
points.body: + → LIVE → LIVE Center → LIVE Events → Create an event.

points.label: Why
points.body: It shows in each viewer's local time — a warm crowd on arrival.

takeaway: Build the audience before you start.

hook: A LIVE can be allowed and still get buried.

points.label: Two layers
points.body: Not removed is not the same as eligible for recommendation.

points.label: What hurts reach
points.body: Mature themes, low-effort streams, aggressive gift-begging.

points.label: Protect yourself
points.body: Never show your address, IDs, or exact location on camera.

takeaway: Allowed isn't the same as promoted.

hook: Got a LIVE warning? Do NOT make a second account.

points.label: Read it
points.body: Open the exact notice and the guideline it cites.

points.label: Appeal
points.body: Inbox → System notifications → Account updates → Appeal.

points.label: Never
points.body: Evading with a new account or fake age makes it worse.
